allow: PowerShell(Stop-Process -Name "node" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $port = netstat -ano | findstr ":3000" | Select-String "LISTENING"; if \($port\) { $pid = \($port -split '\\s+'\)[-1]; Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Host "All cleared")
